name: lore-monorepo
description: Alepha Lore: the app, its CLI and its client

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude lore-monorepo --exclude alepha --exclude @alepha/ui -j 4 run typecheck
scripts.check:deps: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude alepha --exclude @alepha/ui exec depcheck .
scripts.check:i18n: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude alepha --exclude @alepha/ui run check:i18n
scripts.check:migrations: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude alepha --exclude @alepha/ui run check:migrations
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach -Apt --exclude alepha --exclude @alepha/ui run build
